summary: Tested the new PIN auth, PIN change, Super Admin directory and PYQ login-next with REAL auth: real FastAPI app, real JWT cookies, no auth.current override. Everything ran against the isolated DB tejas_isolated_iter154, which was dropped at the end (leftover real handles = 0, storage PUTs = 0). Customer DB and prod were not touched, and no real owner credentials were used. Backend: test_iter154_pin_auth_isolated.py 26/27 pass and test_iter154_pyq_bridge.py 4/4 pass. Verified: signup normalizes the number and stores a $2b$ bcrypt hash with no secret leak; httpOnly+Secure cookies are set. Invalid, unicode, newline, int, mismatched and missing PINs are rejected, and injected role/pin_version fields get 422. Leading-zero PIN 0007 works. Duplicate and legacy pre-PIN numbers cannot be claimed (409) and legacy number login is denied. Per-number limit is 5 then 429 with Retry-After, and the per-IP limit is 60. PIN change is 401 for anon and malformed JWT, 403 for another student, owner and reviewer. Version CAS works: 3 concurrent changes gave [200,409,409]. Old access and refresh tokens fail after a change, the new cookie works, and only the new PIN can log in. A delayed old login or a session inserted later is rejected. A legacy version-0 session can set a PIN with the same id and attempts kept. A tampered role field still gives a student. Staff rotation still revokes staff sessions without touching students. /api/admin/students: owner 200, reviewer/student 403, anon 401; forged headers ignored; role revocation takes effect at once. Items contain only id+phone, Cache-Control is no-store, 50 per page, search works and malformed q/page give 422. CORS and the Origin check work, and route contracts plus OpenAPI x-owner-policy cover all 4 new routes. PYQ via bridge: 30 papers, 75 questions each, years [2026,2025], no answer/source keys, own active/completed fixtures correct, other student isolated, import status is owner-only. Browser (preview frontend with all /api routed to the isolated real-auth bridge): from /exams/jee-main/pyq the app redirects to /login?next=, the switch to signup keeps next, and signup lands on the real 30-paper catalogue. Resume Test, View Result, Attempt Again and the 2025 filter work. Unsafe next values (external, //, backslash, tab) go to /home; safe /profile?tab=saved is kept. Change PIN dialog: phone field read-only, mismatch error, success toast, cookies rotated, old session 401, old PIN rejected, new PIN works; no public reset. Super Admin: nav link for owner only, reviewer sees the denied page, student is redirected to owner-login. Directory showed 67 numbers, 2 pages, search, empty state, and error+Retry (500 injected). No overflow at 1920x800 or 390x844. No email, payment or OTP fields or calls. Landing FAQ and privacy wording are accurate. Found 1 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM and several minor issues.

critical.issue: The IP limiter uses request.client.host. Behind the k8s ingress this is the ingress pod IP: backend logs show only 10.81.4.212/10.81.4.213 for all traffic, and uvicorn runs without --proxy-headers. So 'pin:ip:{ip}' is one shared site-wide bucket of 60 PIN logins+signups+changes per 15 min. Real students will get 429 at modest load, and anyone can lock out all student logins with 60 requests using any valid-format numbers.

minor.issue: MEDIUM: the per-number limiter counts before verification and never resets on success. The 6th SUCCESSFUL login within 15 min returns 429 (observed [200,200,200,200,200,429]). This blocks students who sign in on several devices or re-login. Staff /auth/login deletes its key on success; the phone path does not.

MEDIUM (latent): new_session() picks the identity plane from u['access_type'] and defaults to staff_password. change_pin passes the raw DB doc. For a phone profile with no access_type field, the PIN update COMMITS (pin_version=1), then the call returns 401 'Staff credentials changed during sign-in' and every later PIN login also returns 401, so the profile is permanently locked out. Reproduced in test_legacy_profile_without_access_type_field_can_set_pin. Historical inserts included access_type, so the risk is low but real for any imported or legacy doc.

Old-version session rows are only fenced logically and never physically deleted: 9 stale rows remained after a change. Add sessions.delete_many({'user_id':id,'access_type':'unverified_phone','pin_version':{'$lt':new}}) as cleanup.
Sorted by random UUID id, so the list order looks random to the owner. Sort by phone or created_at. One audit row is written per read, including every debounced search keystroke.

ui_bugs.issue: There is no client-side PIN/confirm mismatch check. The server 422 shows the generic 'Request fields or values do not match this operation’s contract.' instead of 'PINs must match.' (ChangePin already checks on the client).

issues: Initial focus goes to the read-only phone field (text selected, red focus ring). Autofocus New PIN instead.
A 1920 screenshot taken right after opening showed page content through the dialog. This is most likely the fade-in animation (at 390 after 500ms it was opaque). Optional check.
Optional: mention that the owner can view registered mobile numbers in the Super Admin directory.

action_items: HIGH: Derive the client IP for limit_pin from the trusted X-Forwarded-For hop, or run uvicorn with --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips set to the ingress CIDR. Keep the per-IP limit from becoming a global bucket. Consider a separate key per action.
Reset or skip counting the per-number login limiter on a successful PIN login (delete the key like staff login does), or count failures only.
In phone.access and change_pin, call new_session({**doc, 'role':'student', 'access_type':'unverified_phone'}). Optionally verify the plane before committing the PIN CAS.
Add a client-side 'PINs must match.' check in Auth.js signup, and/or map the PhoneSignupPayload model_validator error to a friendly message.
Physically delete stale student sessions after a PIN change (logical fencing already works).
Optional: sort the directory by phone/created_at; autofocus New PIN in the ChangePin dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: phone.py limit_pin: request.client.host behind the proxy (see HIGH issue). The shared key 'pin:ip:' spans login, signup and change.
auth.new_session trusts u['access_type'] from the caller's dict. identity() forces the plane for existing sessions, but the login/change paths do not.
signup builds a PhoneProfile with _id != id (two uuids). This works, but two identifiers per doc is confusing; the directory reads 'id' correctly.
students.py: q pattern allows '+', spaces, () and -, and digits are regex-escaped. This is safe; malformed q returns 422 as expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional; 1 UX bug (signup mismatch message)

test_credentials: Only ephemeral synthetic owner/reviewer/student credentials (random password/PIN), created inside tejas_isolated_iter154 and held in /tmp/iter154_creds.json (0600), which was deleted with the DB. No real owner credential was read, used or changed, and no customer-DB writes were made. memory/test_credentials.md was not changed.
seed_data_creation: Only in the isolated DB (dropped): 2 staff, about 70 synthetic phone profiles, the reviewed PYQ bundle imported via the real owner step endpoint, and 2 attempt fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real-auth isolated harness: iso_harness_iter154.py (no override; clock OFFSET via fresh_window for limiter windows). Run pytest with -n0 (xdist is the default). Bridge: cd /app/backend/tests && timeout 2400 python iso_bridge_iter154.py & (port 8792; drops the DB on SIGTERM). Browser: page.route('**/*') forwards preview /api/* to the bridge with a Python-side cookie jar (set-cookie stripped). Attempt fixtures need title/exam/start_key fields, otherwise /my/tests returns 500 (fixture artifact, not an app bug). The student number hits the 5/15min login limit quickly because successes count, so clear tejas_phone_limits in the ISOLATED DB between runs. Use valid intl numbers (+44 7700 900xxx is invalid in libphonenumber).
rca of the issue: IP limiter: Starlette request.client comes from the ASGI scope client. Uvicorn only rewrites it from X-Forwarded-For when proxy_headers is on and the peer is in forwarded_allow_ips (default 127.0.0.1). The ingress peers 10.81.4.x are not trusted, so every request shares the ingress IP. Legacy lockout: change_pin returns new_session(updated). new_session reads updated.get('access_type','staff_password'), so a missing field sends it to the staff branch, the users lookup misses, and it returns 401 after the PIN CAS has already committed.
